python3 -c 'import sys,json,re,statistics as st,subprocess,tarfile,datetime
from pathlib import Path
f=Path(sys.argv[1])
t=tarfile.open(f)
def med(arm):
 return st.median(float(re.search(r"^tps = ([\d.]+)",t.extractfile(m).read().decode(),re.M)[1]) for m in t.getnames() if re.fullmatch("pa/wsp-runs/p01-"+arm+"-t[12]/pgbench-p01.txt",m))
print(100*med("off")/med("off"))' "$F"
